tests.description: I-1: STAGE_END trigger fires checkpoint agent at stage boundary. After implementation-review completes stage 1, checkpoint-stage-end-only must be dispatched before stage 2's first workflow agent. Uses a checkpoint variant with only STAGE_END trigger (no INVOCATION_INTERVAL) to isolate the test.
